meta.title: Prepare the PRs used in all cases

steps.note: Enable the required team-category filtering configuration before preparing the PRs.

args.goal: In the Buyer portal Test Data area, create or upload PR-1 through PR-12 with the specified line counts, categories, locations, quantities, and partial-quantity condition; note each generated PR No.; stop when the created PR records and their PR numbers are visible.

steps.note: No catalog step creates or uploads PR test data, so perform this preparation directly in the buyer session.
Open the Purchase Requisitions list to verify the prepared records in the supported PR flow.
The case requires all prepared PRs to be available in the Open tab.
Assert that the Open PR list contains at least the twelve prepared PR records.
